triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Bug · Broken (the filter builder offers equals and in for a multi-select field, and the server refuses both with 400) · end users filtering on multi-select fields, not every user every time → p2 under the UX rule · reported with the request and answer by an outside builder. Overlaps the filter redo #35549 in topic #35547 (the list-page redo the maintainer ordered: 「这个要重新立专题了」); this defect ships on its own.

Stop on any other breach and report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: the builders keyed operators on the field type alone and never learned the #21007/#21009 JSON-column refusal set
Thread-read: 7014176715
Premise: holds at `origin/main` `9a8bb83d4c` by the card (multi-select offers 等于/不等于/属于/不属于, server answers 400 INVALID_FILTER; `contains` works over REST and is never offered). The dev re-measures in the browser before code.
Serial constraints cleared: no open ux-3 card; ux-2 and ux-4 surfaces fenced above; seat 1 also claims area:ux cards, so this claim re-reads the card's thread before landing. overlap-check against main before every push; the second to land merges main.
Pre-claim lane: `ui/packages/plugin-list/**`, `ui/packages/components/**` → `domain:ui`, area ux-3.
Pre-claim deps: none.
Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 35559 --terms operator,multiple,contains,filter,multiselect --paths` over FilterValuePanel.tsx, components filter-builder.tsx and json-column-operator-refusal.ts at origin/main `9a8bb83d4c`: no ruling on the card's thread (0 of 1 comment); ADR hits generic (ADR-0061 D3, ADR-0098 §5, ADR-0147 §2 proposed, ADR-0155 D1, ADR-0019, ADR-0021), none governs which operators a UI offers.
